text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After taking on the grand stage in Dubai, the plan was to challenge Hong Kong, and then France.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
My right leg is aching a bit after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dream of the world hasn't faded. However,
pushing too hard now could make the condition much worse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If bad news reaches the public now,
all her hard work in Dubai will be for nothing."
choice_data_list: ...Shall we give up on it this time?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
......
Yes... That's true. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving up on the worldwide campaign for now,
she returned home temporarily to regroup.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
V-Victoire-chan!?
Wah, I saw how amazing you were in Dubai!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations~!
We got super hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Mom.
That's the Umamusume who won in Dubai like I told you about!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... Oh! You mean that kid you and Dad were so thrilled about, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san...!
You did it~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for your return!!
Time for a feast, a feeeast~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Wait. First, you need some rest.
...Welcome back, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm home.
It feels a little ticklish to say that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was eagerly awaiting your return.
So much so that even the Ruler was jealous.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Regardless, please rest for now. And... when the time is right, there is something I would like to discuss with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after returning to the country, Rose Kingdom paid a visit to the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"What I wanted to consult you about is—
concerning the Fan Appreciation Festival event."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Fan Appreciation Festival is an event where Tracen Academy opens its doors to the public, centered around interacting with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Many people are still hurting deeply
from the great earthquake in March.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"It's not a wound that will heal easily.
However... seeing your victory in Dubai made me feel something."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That joy is a stepping stone toward hope.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So, we decided to plan a concert for this year's Fan Appreciation Day. We're also planning a livestream for anyone who can't attend in person.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Would you please consider performing
as one of the main members for that live show?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My...
I am honored by your invitation.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If I can be of service, please allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, fou—♪
...—♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Chairwoman Akikawa's cooperation,
the announcement of the concert was made on a grand scale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With each passing day, more and more volunteers joined,
both as concert performers and backstage staff—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, it had become one of the main events of this year's Fan Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And then.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: We've all finally met—♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone!
Are you ready to have some fun?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
For today's live, taking photos is actually allowed.
Once you've had lots of fun, please share that excitement with someone else.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Let's make the most of today and have a blast♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Run through this moment, it can't end yet
Because there's a place I want to reach
Keep pushing forward beyond it—♪

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Clasping even the tears tightly to my chest,
that is where the story begins ♪

text_block_list.name: Buena & Orfe
text_block_list.text:
Resonate, fanfare♪
Reach all the way to the goal line,
'Cause I want to see a shining future with you—♪

text_block_list.name: Buena & Orfe
text_block_list.text:
Let's sprint through the path meant just for you
Even faster
I believe, beyond our dreams♪

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hahaha...!! I was hesitating, but
I'm so glad I came! This is the best! The absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
—Let's spread the word! Add tags,
and post all our best shots...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should send the stream link to that girl who closed her social media, too.
She really loved racing, after all...
I hope it cheers her up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The excitement in the venue connected, spreading far and wide—
with concurrent live viewers surpassing one million...!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"What a massive festival!" "How inappropriate."
"I don't know racing, but came 'cause it was trending."
"We're all watching together at the community center!"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text: "Opinions are split, but I'm just happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume sang, danced,
and kept waving with bright smiles. And then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The next song will be our last.
Before that, though... please allow me
to say just one thing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This was back when I was running in the Junior Class.
Desperate to catch up to the level of those around me, I trained late into the night every day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of it all—
A friend began lighting a lantern
by the window for me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I felt embarrassed that they were worrying about me,
so I told them to stop.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
When I saw that light,
my nervousness truly melted away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It reminded me of the warmth of a palm, which I had forgotten during those days of continuous tension.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
""I am here, and everyone is here.
So, it'll be alright"—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Her wish
is now my wish as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Let us move forward together.
For surely, the future must be bright."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash's words brought the entire venue even closer together.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Your voice...
Your voice is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"The dream I share with everyone
Will go on forever and ever—♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our voices became one,
ringing out high and far—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To receive such kind words...
Thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Everyone's smiles and comments... each and every one of them is so incredibly warm.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I meant to encourage them,
but it seems I was the one who received energy instead.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just as all of you were for me,
I hope the singing that resonated here today
becomes a light of hope for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their words brought the entire venue
even closer together as one.

text_block_list.name: Singing Throughout the Venue
text_block_list.text:
Your voice (turns into power)...
Your voice (becomes the future)...

text_block_list.name: Singing Throughout the Venue
text_block_list.text:
"The dream I share with everyone
Will go on forever and ever—♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our voices became one,
ringing out high and far—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text: —Huh. Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: "Oh, long time no see."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Little by little, Japan had begun to move forward.
